hero.headline: Websites that load fast, look sharp, and turn visitors into clients.
hero.subhead: I design, build, and deploy custom websites for businesses, restaurants, studios, and consultants — one person, start to finish, with an AI-accelerated workflow that never cuts corners on quality.

about.title: Based in Kampala. Working with clients everywhere.
about.paragraph1: I'm a self-taught web developer with three years of hands-on experience building sites for real clients — from an NGO impact dashboard to restaurant and consultant websites launched from scratch.
about.paragraph2: I use AI tools the way a good carpenter uses power tools: to work faster, not to skip the craftsmanship. Every site is still designed, tested, and reviewed line by line before it goes live.

sections.heading: Note on registration & address
body: I operate as an individual freelancer based in Uganda, outside the European Union. There is no German commercial register entry, no VAT identification number, and no published street address, as none of these apply to a non-EU sole proprietor of this kind.

This notice is provided on a good-faith, best-effort basis for visitors from Germany and the EU, even though formal Impressumspflicht enforceability against a business established outside the EU is limited.

body: The content on this website has been created with care. However, I cannot guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or timeliness of the content. As a service provider, I am responsible for my own content on these pages under general law, but am not obligated to monitor transmitted or stored third-party information.

Obligations to remove or block the use of information under general law remain unaffected. Any liability in this regard is only possible from the point in time at which a concrete infringement becomes known. Upon notification of such violations, this content will be removed promptly.

sections.heading: Liability for links
body: This website contains links to external third-party websites over whose content I have no influence. Therefore, I cannot assume any liability for this external content. The respective provider or operator of the linked pages is always responsible for their content.

The linked pages were checked for possible legal violations at the time of linking. Illegal content was not recognizable at that time. Permanent monitoring of the content of linked pages is not reasonable without concrete evidence of an infringement. Upon notification of violations, such links will be removed promptly.

sections.heading: Copyright
body: The content and works created by the site operator on this website are subject to copyright law. Reproduction, editing, distribution, and any kind of use outside the limits of copyright law require the written consent of the respective author.

Insofar as the content on this site was not created by the operator, third-party copyrights are respected and marked as such. Should you nonetheless become aware of a copyright infringement, please notify me by email and such content will be removed promptly.

sections.heading: Dispute resolution
body: The European Commission provides a platform for online dispute resolution: https://ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr/. I am not obligated and not willing to participate in dispute resolution proceedings before a consumer arbitration board.

datenschutz.title: Privacy Policy
datenschutz.intro: This policy explains, in plain terms, what happens to data when you visit this website — and, just as importantly, what does not.

sections.heading: Responsible party
body: Omwata John Charles, Kampala, Uganda.
Email: omwatajohncharles@gmail.com · Phone: +256 779 239 902

sections.heading: Hosting
body: This website is statically hosted by Vercel Inc. (San Francisco, USA). To operate and secure the infrastructure, Vercel's servers may automatically process technical log data such as IP address, browser type, and access timestamps. I do not have direct access to this data and do not use it myself. Details are available in Vercel's privacy policy: https://vercel.com/legal/privacy-policy.

sections.heading: No cookies, no analytics, no tracking
body: This site does not set cookies, does not use analytics or advertising scripts, and does not run any visitor-tracking technology of any kind. No personal data is collected, stored, or processed by the website itself.

sections.heading: Contact via email or phone
body: The email and phone links on this site open your own email or phone app. Any information you choose to share this way — your address, name, or message — is handled entirely through your own provider and is used solely to reply to your enquiry. It is never stored on or by this website.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: If you are located in the EU, the GDPR gives you the right to access, correct, delete, or restrict the processing of your personal data, the right to data portability, and the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority. To exercise any of these rights, contact me by email.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
body: This policy may be updated from time to time to reflect changes to the site or to legal requirements. The version published here is always the current one.
